Name: Reuel
Summary: Reuel was a son of Esau by Bashemath, and the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
KeyStory: Reuel's four sons became dukes in Edom, carrying his mother Bashemath's line forward.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Bashemath, Daughter of Ishmael; Nahath; Zerah, Son of Reuel; Shammah; Mizzah
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
